verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing copy mentions creating custom automations (reminders, rules to move work forward) via Rovo AI and customizable workflows, implying a no-code automation capability, but the evidence pack lacks any detailed documentation of a dedicated multi-step automation builder (triggers/conditions/actions) or community validation of its use. Missing for 10: dedicated automation-engine docs, examples of multi-step rule chains, and independent/hands-on evidence of non-developers building automations successfully.
